rule_outs: Dwelling 10 m from the best section
summary: Short, steep residential kerb with houses 8-10 m away on the same side.
reasons: Narrow street, almost no cars parked

drivers.seclusion: Houses at 10 m (at 19 m) and 8 m (at 47 m) on the same side; homes close all round.
drivers.access_and_room: Narrow lane with kerb-to-hedge verge; only room for a van at the edge of the lane.
drivers.convention: No signs; few cars parked here, so a van would stand out.

flags: Steep: 10.8% mean, 16% max, about 8.5% at best section
sun_shade: Hedges and trees shade from the east; open to the west afternoon sun.

best_section.where: East kerb of Bide Street between the two southern cross streets, mid-block
